attchmntText: Mcleod Russel India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: McLeod Russel India Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The advertisement was published on 15th November 2026 in Financial Express and Aajkaal. The Board of Directors approved the financial results on 14th November 2026. Standalone total income from operations was 47,696.37 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Standalone net profit after tax was 28,076.27 lakhs. Consolidated total income from operations was 60,020.04 lakhs. Consolidated net profit after tax was 10,125.16 lakhs. Earnings per share for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was 9.98 rupees on a basic basis. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.

attchmntText: Stanley Lifestyles Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Stanley Lifestyles Limited filed its earnings call presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with the NSE and BSE. The presentation is scheduled for November 16, 2026. Revenue from operations increased by 1.6% year-on-year to Rs. 10,706 lakhs in Q2 FY27. For H1 FY27, revenue was Rs. 20,641 lakhs. The company opened its first international store in Colombo, Sri Lanka, in July 2026. A new Stanley Superlative Living store opened in Hyderabad in September 2026. Sofas and More stores launched in Jaipur in August 2026. The order book stood at Rs. 6,020 lakhs as of September 30, 2026. Cash and liquid funds were Rs. 17,482 lakhs. The company is proposing the amalgamation of subsidiaries into Stanley Lifestyles Limited.

attchmntText: Themis Medicare Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Themis Medicare Limited submitted an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. For Q2 FY27, net revenue grew 15.1% year-on-year to Rs. 89.74 crore. The company reported a return to operating profitability with EBITDA of Rs. 5.58 crore at a 6.2% margin. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 7.06 crore, compared to a loss in the year-ago quarter. API business revenue rebounded by 71% to Rs. 20 crore. For H1 FY27, total revenue was Rs. 176.70 crore. The presentation highlighted strong performance in the Critical Care and Ortho divisions. The company remains focused on operational efficiency and expanding its hospital business presence.

attchmntText: Stanley Lifestyles Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 15, 2026, titled "EARNINGS CALL PRESS RELEASE FOR THE Q2 FY 2026-27".
voiceSummary: Stanley Lifestyles Limited announced unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 10,706 Lakhs, up 1.6% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 1,989 Lakhs with margins of 18.6%. Adjusted PAT for the quarter was Rs. 329 Lakhs. attchmntText: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone revenue for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 47.5 crore, up 12% year-on-year. EBITDA was Rs. 17.7 crore, down 15.3% year-on-year. Profit after tax was Rs. 8.5 crore, down 40.6% year-on-year. H1 FY27 standalone revenue stood at Rs. 91.2 crore, up 16.7% year-on-year. H1 EBITDA was Rs. 38.5 crore, up 10.5% year-on-year. H1 profit after tax was Rs. 19.5 crore, down 16.3% year-on-year. Consolidated results were impacted by foreign exchange losses of Rs. 15.57 crore and one-off expenses of Rs. 1.2 crore. The company acquired MicroBiopharm Japan for JPY 21.5 billion. It also agreed to acquire a portfolio from Sanofi for approximately EUR 158 million. The new fermentation facility was commissioned, impacting near-term margins.

attchmntText: Allcargo Global Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 15, 2026, titled "Press release on unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Allcargo Global Limited submitted its press release on unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. On a consolidated basis, Q2 FY27 revenue stood at 4320 crore, registering a 23% sequential growth. EBITDA increased to 122 crore, compared with 33 crore in Q1 FY27, registering a sequential growth of 270%. The company reported a Profit After Tax of 32 crore in Q2 FY27, compared with a loss of 28 crore in Q1 FY27. Gross profit increased 14% QoQ to 837 crore. LCL volumes grew 3% over the previous quarter, while FCL and Air volumes increased by 1% and 16%, respectively. The company reported a PBT of 62 crore during Q2FY27. This intimation is being uploaded on the Company’s website.
